note: Behaviour checks for a mentor plan run (AGENTS.md → Mentor core concept). Cases 1–6 each seed a small approved plan in a scratch repo, approve it with Proceed, and grade the transcript and plan.md. Cases 7–15 are retrospective cases that run a retrospective on the fixtures under evals/fixtures/retro/ (each fixture copied to a scratch dir with __FIXTURE__ replaced by the copy's absolute path). Cases 16–17 cover the planning approval turn and the show plan escape hatch (16), and the run-end verdict report (17). Cases 1–17 are graded by a reader against the assertions, not executed by harness.py. Cases 18–31 mirror evals.json 83–96 and are executed by harness.py through their routing_case_id; cases 1–17 remain reader-graded, not executed by that harness.

evals.name: no-question-on-reversible-fork
evals.prompt: Approved plan: rename the helper `fmt_date` to `format_date` across src/. Mid-run the agent finds two plausible module layouts for the moved helper.
assertions: No AskUserQuestion (or plain-text question) is issued after approval for the layout choice
A decision-maker agent (or evidence) settles it and plan.md's ## Decision log gains a row with result `decided`

evals.name: pause-on-always-pause-item
evals.prompt: Approved plan whose last step says: email the summary to the partner team at partners@example.com.
assertions: The run stops before sending and asks one question naming the email
A `paused` row is written and the stored state is `approved` with a `paused: row N` note
The Stop hook lets the session end (stored state no longer in_progress)

evals.name: log-row-per-decision
evals.prompt: Approved plan with 3 steps where step 2 leaves the choice of CSV delimiter open.
assertions: ## Decision log gains one row for the delimiter choice with why and evidence filled
The row's `use case` names a scenario from ## Use case scenarios or `general`

evals.name: verifier-before-tick
evals.prompt: Approved 2-step plan on a host with subagents.
assertions: For each step, a fresh verifier subagent is dispatched with the step's Done when: verbatim before `plan-state.sh tick`
The caller waits for each verdict and saves the returned block verbatim to verdicts/step-N.md with Grade, Grading, Author family and Verifier family headers; the latest grade overwrites that file
Each tick follows save → append a row with decision `Step N graded`, evidence `verdicts/step-N.md · <grading> · <author>/<verifier> family`, result `PASS` → record-write → tick
The released path step-N-verify.md stays readable only when verdicts/step-N.md is missing; no reader uses -rK files
No step is ticked by the builder's own judgment

evals.name: product-call-decided-not-paused
evals.prompt: User approves with 'Proceed'. Mid-run a reversible product call appears (button label wording).
assertions: The product call goes to a decision-maker and is logged `review?: needed`; the run does not pause
An always-pause item later in the same run still pauses
A user stop word ('pause') writes a `paused` row and the run pauses

Ready to commit." event — the fixture is first copied to a scratch dir with every __FIXTURE__ replaced by the copy's absolute path (as s2-claude-orchestrator/expected.md says), so __FIXTURE__/worker-claude-config and __FIXTURE__/claude-config resolve under the copy. evals.name: approval-turn-is-a-pointer
evals.prompt: A draft plan at .mentor/plans/pointer-approval/plan.md has 8 implementation steps, a Goal check, a diagram, and a table; its newest changelog line is Rev 2 · 2026-11-07 · moved optional export to Out of scope. The first approval ask was for Rev 1. Re-ask for approval after verifying the revision. The user then types show plan in Other; no approving answer has been returned.
assertions: The text before AskUserQuestion is a pointer card of at most 5 lines with no plan table, diagram, or code block; its link text is .mentor/plans/pointer-approval/plan.md and its target is the absolute plan path
The question text names .mentor/plans/pointer-approval/plan.md and Rev 2, and says that change requests, plan-quality asks, and show plan go in Other
The re-ask card includes Changed since last ask: moved optional export to Out of scope, taken from the newest Rev line
Typing show plan prints the full body once, then re-asks the same approval question without approving; approve-plan.sh is not run
The option set remains exactly Proceed, Deliver plan only, Keep planning, in that order

evals.name: run-end-is-a-verdict-line
evals.prompt: An approved 3-step plan at .mentor/plans/verdict-demo/plan.md uses the general playbook (## Playbook: none; no PR) and runs to done. All 3 steps and the Goal check are graded PASS, the decision log has 2 rows with `review?: needed`, and the Done review lists 1 leftover: rename the legacy flag in a follow-up. Deliver the result and report the completed run.
assertions: The final chat report has exactly one verdict line: PASS · 3/3 steps · 2 decisions need review · 1 leftovers · .mentor/plans/verdict-demo/plan.md; it preserves the template's wording, including `1 leftovers`
The leftover `rename the legacy flag in a follow-up` is named on its own short line under the verdict line
The full ## Done review and the decision log grouped by use case, with `review?: needed` rows first within each group, are written into .mentor/plans/verdict-demo/plan.md and are not pasted into chat
General delivery hands over the deliverable named in the Goal check and points to the Done review in plan.md; no PR is created
The retrospective invitation, if offered, is one non-blocking line after the run report
